about: Named OpenAPI examples for pubky.app features, built from the staging seed list. pinakesd adds them to its public OpenAPI document (Swagger UI dropdowns), tests/recipes.rs runs every one against a fixture of the same URIs, and docs/api.md lists them under 'Recipes for pubky.app'. In strings, id(URI) becomes that URI's resource ID and group(URI,URI,...) the ID a group of those members gets when it forms.

recipes.name: link-preview-video
recipes.summary: Link preview while composing: a YouTube video
recipes.feature: The composer shows a card (title, image, type) for a link the user pastes.

recipes.name: link-preview-event
recipes.summary: Link preview while composing: a Luma event
recipes.feature: An event link becomes an event card with its date and venue.

recipes.name: feed-cards
recipes.summary: Feed link cards for a page of posts
recipes.feature: The feed renders the cards for every link in the visible posts with one request.

recipes.name: map-viewport
recipes.feature: The map draws clusters and single pins for the visible area, one pin per group.

recipes.name: nearby-places
recipes.feature: A 'near me' list: places within 5 km of a point.

recipes.name: upcoming-events
recipes.feature: An events tab: events and calendar dates in a time window, sorted by start.

recipes.name: tag-page
recipes.summary: Tag page: everything tagged bitcoin, with related tags
recipes.feature: A tag page lists tagged links and shows the tags that co-occur with it.

recipes.name: social-reach
recipes.summary: What the people I follow tagged (replace viewer with an existing user)
recipes.feature: A personal feed: links tagged by users the viewer follows. The viewer must exist in the Nexus this instance reads; this placeholder does not.

recipes.name: calendar-dates
recipes.summary: Calendar dates of a feed (Swiss holidays)
recipes.feature: A subscribed calendar shows its upcoming dates.

recipes.name: place-detail
recipes.feature: Tapping a place opens its card with location, address and attribution.

recipes.name: book-detail
recipes.feature: A book link opens its card with title and authors.

recipes.name: article-group
recipes.summary: One article, two links: the Nature page and its DOI
recipes.feature: Links to the same thing collapse into one group with one best card.

recipes.name: recent-changes
recipes.feature: A sync job follows the change feed to refresh cached cards.

recipes.name: my-links-changed
recipes.summary: Freshness: did the links I posted change?
recipes.feature: Notify a user when an event they shared moved or a card changed.
